items.title: How Will Southern Stock React To Its Upcoming Earnings?
items.summary: Southern (NYSE:SO) is scheduled to report its earnings on Thursday, November 5, 2026. The company has a market value of about $106.6 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $30.2 billion in revenue and $7.3 billion in operating profit, with net income of $4.7 billion.
